name: Ramesh Placeholder

transcript.text: What problems or symptoms are you having right now?
Swallowing is very painful, I can take only dal water and juice. My weight has gone down a lot.
Since when, and how bad is the pain out of ten?
Since the fourth week of radiation. The pain is 7 out of 10 when I swallow.
Which medicines do you take now?
Tramadol at night for the pain, and homeopathy drops my neighbour suggested.
Do you use or have you used tobacco or alcohol?
I chewed gutka for twenty years. I stopped last year when the ulcer came.
Do you have earlier reports or scans?
I did an MRI at the district hospital in August. I don't have that report with me.
Thank you. I will share this with your doctor.
